subject: [PATCH v5 5/7] sched/numa: scan PID-inactive VMAs for promotion

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Addressed Sashiko's report feedback, stating that the patch has low impact and may not be worth the churn. However, acknowledged a potential issue with prev_scan_seq update.

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the potential issue with prev_scan_seq update and stated that it will be addressed in another commit.

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch series enhances the vma scanning logic in the Linux kernel's scheduler to promote hot slow-tier memory by bypassing a filter that skips VMAs without recent PID activity. The patch introduces a new sequence ID for placement scans and updates the starvation horizon calculation to prevent promotion-only scans from postponing placement indefinitely.
